Revival of banked downgraded parent stat_cate_local_overlap_nuisance_frontier (v1), targeting its exact-uniform bounded-overlap converse that remained open. This attempt uses a joint-cell correlated-prior construction and sparse latent-sign graph component control of the full fixed-n mixture likelihood. The parent already tried smooth overlapping frames; the new ingredient is the component affinity and random-geometric-graph bound that replaces the failed partition-local transfer. Resolve the same-class below-elbow minimax rate with a matching total estimator; the rate answer remains open for independent verification. The parent all-kappa oracle theorem and unmatched upper bracket alone do not discharge this kernel. MODEL: For every fixed d>=1, alpha>0, beta>0, gamma>beta, L>=4 with S=alpha+beta<d*gamma/(2*gamma+d), observe n>=2 iid (X,A,Y). X has exactly the known uniform law on [0,1]^d. A|X=x is Bernoulli(g(x)/4), with g in H^alpha(L), 1<=g<=2. Y|(X=x,A=a) is Bernoulli(mu_a(x)), mu0 in H^beta(L), tau=mu1-mu0 in H^gamma(L), and 1/8<=mu0,mu1<=7/8. H^s(L) bounds derivatives through m=ceil(s)-1 by L and the order-m derivatives have (s-m)-Holder seminorm <=L under the sup norm. No smoothness of the marginal outcome mean is assumed. The estimator knows d,alpha,beta,gamma,L and uniform design, but not g,mu0,tau. Target is the unique continuous version tau(0); conditional exchangeability and consistency provide the causal interpretation. This is precisely the parent kappa=0 subproblem, preserving its exact-support restriction. KERNEL: Determine the sharp order of R_n=inf_T sup_P E_P|T(O_1,...,O_n)-tau_P(0)| over all Borel data-only estimators on the exact model above, for every stated fixed parameter tuple and all n>=2. Deliver an explicit deterministic rate rho_n (including any logarithmic factors), constants 0<c<=C<infinity depending only on the fixed parameters, c*rho_n<=R_n<=C*rho_n, and a total finite computable attaining estimator. Resolve whether the published candidate n^(-1/(1+d/(2gamma)+d/(2S))) is sharp on exact uniform support or supply a sharper matched replacement; the answer is open, not imposed. Characterize when the same-class oracle benchmark n^(-gamma/(2gamma+d)) remains attainable in this below-published-elbow regime. The required lower bound must concern fixed-n iid product laws in this exact full-support Bernoulli class. A conditional or Poissonized proof must prove a valid reduction back to that experiment. COMPUTATION: Use the parent finite projection U-statistic/local polynomial estimator if its rate is matched; if the class yields a faster rate, give an explicit finite projection or higher-order correction estimator with deterministic tuning, singular-matrix fallback and clipping. Frame/likelihood calculations for a lower bound are proof mechanics, not model assumptions. CONSUMER: The parent names the grf causal_forest/R-learner workflow for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects from observational data with learned propensity/outcome regressions. This theorem tells users when nuisance learning imposes an unavoidable pointwise precision penalty even under benign known covariate design, or whether that penalty is avoidable. It is a precision benchmark, not a claim that existing forests attain it; no application is changed from the parent. PRIOR ART: The parent receipts say the published higher-order upper rate already applies to exact known uniform design, but the perforated-support lower laws do not. The target is the missing full-support fixed-n converse or a sharper matched same-class answer. Sparse latent-sign component control is the presolved replacement for the failed partition-local affinity argument; no new literature review is claimed. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The presolver derives a full-support Bernoulli lower family using a smooth squared partition of unity and correlated signs, with a deterministic macro contrast and exact one-observation mixture cancellation. Conditional on the observed covariates, connect observations whose local frames share a sign. Product mixtures factor over components, singleton components agree, and a mixed-derivative bound controls each remaining component by a²b² times a polynomial and exponential in its size. A spanning-tree count gives a total fixed-n squared Hellinger bound of order n² h^d ell^d a²b². Below the nuisance elbow, n ell^d is small at the proposed tuning, yielding the missing nuisance-rate converse without deleting support. Root separately checked rational cell normalization, shared-coefficient mixture leakage, disjoint-component cancellation, overlapping pair/triple examples, and unequal-smoothness rate exponents. These finite checks do not prove the analytic theorem.
UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Independently verify the smooth-frame support and Hölder estimates, component mixed-derivative constants, geometric-graph counting, and the inherited upper estimator; the presolver reports an analytic closure, not a certified theorem.
EARLY KILL TEST: On d=1, alpha=beta=1/8, gamma=1, verify the full fixed-n component factorization and affinity estimate at ell proportional to n^(-8/7); stop if an uncancelled singleton or macro-scale leakage term survives.
